item.title: Nearby Aircraft Display
item.description: I have an ADS-B node feeding data into the vast network of flight trackers, but it mostly just sits on my roof humming along without any interaction from me. I can, and have, looked at the webpage that shows my local flight data and the planes on a map, but it didn’t quite have the whimsy I was after. I decided a wall-mounted device that displayed the aircraft type closest to my location at any given moment would be a fun build.
